metadata.residual_definition: For each condition, each model's similarity profile from the central image to the condition-local anchor set is rank/z normalized, averaged across models to form a consensus profile, and residualized by subtracting that consensus.
metadata.annotation_note: The app hides model identities from annotators; hidden_model metadata is retained in cards.json and annotation exports.
